**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Reserve status width while the project is loading**

At the supported 880 px minimum, this shrinkable `min_w_0` item only recovers enough space for the short offline label, but when `state()` is `None`, the additional padded `loading` element appended below consumes that space and can collapse the audio status back to zero width. Cover the real loading state in the compact-width test and reserve enough width for both indicators so startup does not reintroduce the original invisible-status failure.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Refuse Tab while arrangement pan owns the pointer**

When the workspace already has focus and the middle mouse button is holding an arrangement pan, this guard does not check `arrangement_pan`, so an unmodified Tab reaches `set_mode`; that method immediately cancels the pan and switches to Console before mouse-up. Treat the active pan like the other pointer gestures here so Tab cannot interrupt a captured timeline interaction.
